questions.question: What does David resolve to do in Psalm 9?
options: Give thanks to the LORD with his whole heart
Question why the wicked always seem to prosper
Plead for rescue from his enemies
Cry out to the LORD in bitter distress
questions.answer: Give thanks to the LORD with his whole heart

questions.question: How is the LORD described as ruling?
options: He pardons the sins of the penitent
He scatters the proud and the mighty
He gathers the exiles from afar
He judges the world with righteousness
questions.answer: He judges the world with righteousness
